title: Mean curvature is continuous in a C² chart
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝᴺ and let (V, W, ψ), ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ, be a chart of M of class 2 (Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ). Assume that y ↦ tangentProjection M y is continuous on M, that tangentSpace M (ψ x) = range Dψ(x) for every x ∈ V, and that secondFundamentalForm M (ψ x) (Dψ(x)a) (Dψ(x)b) = normalPart M (ψ x) (D²ψ(x)[a, b]) for every x ∈ V and all a, b ∈ ℝⁿ, where D²ψ(x)[a, b] = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x a b. Then x ↦ meanCurvature M (ψ x) is continuous on V.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ → ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M → (∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → (∀ x ∈ V, ∀ a b : Rn n, secondFundamentalForm M (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ ψ x a) (fderiv ℝ ψ x b) = normalPart M (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x a b)) → ContinuousOn (fun x ↦ meanCurvature M (ψ x)) V
